chains.name: Critical Chain: Remote Code Execution (RCE)
chains.description: The correlation engine identified a direct attack path to full server compromise. By combining Unrestricted File Upload with Local File Inclusion (LFI), an attacker can execute arbitrary system commands.
chains.impact: Total system takeover. Attackers can read, modify, or destroy any data, and pivot to internal networks.
recommendations: Break the chain by fixing the File Upload validation (use strict MIME and magic byte checks).
Fix the LFI by avoiding dynamic local file inclusion based on user input.

chains.name: High Risk Chain: Zero-Click Account Takeover
chains.description: The engine identified a severe session hijacking chain. The application suffers from Stored XSS, and the session cookies lack the 'HttpOnly' flag.
chains.impact: An attacker can permanently steal administrative or user session tokens automatically when victims view the infected page.
recommendations: Implement the HttpOnly flag on all session cookies immediately.
Sanitize stored inputs to neutralize the XSS vector.

chains.name: High Risk Chain: Authentication Compromise
chains.description: The application allows weak passwords and lacks brute-force protection, creating a highly exploitable authentication mechanism.
chains.impact: Attackers can easily brute-force user accounts or use credential stuffing to gain unauthorized access.
recommendations: Implement robust rate limiting and account lockout mechanisms.
